actionResult.summary: 066 Apply closes the previously retained 063 implementation findings, but malformed stable-version admission remains fail-open for invalid SemVer build metadata; Author revision required.

reviewFindings.title: Malformed stable SemVer build metadata is admitted instead of failing closed
reviewFindings.problem: The Owner-reset compatibility contract requires malformed OpenSpec versions to fail closed, but supportedVersion accepts invalid SemVer build metadata such as 1.7.0+.., 1.7.0+.abc, 1.7.0+abc., and 1.7.0+abc..def. Reviewer probes confirmed all are accepted by getVersion().
reviewFindings.requiredChange: Use a stable SemVer-valid admission rule (or equivalent exact parser) so only syntactically valid stable SemVer releases at or above 1.7.0 enter machine-contract conformance. Add adversarial tests for empty build identifiers/consecutive or leading/trailing dots while preserving no fixed upper bound and prerelease fail-closed behavior.
